papers.title: Spectroscopic Evidence of Luttinger Liquid Behavior in a Single-Layer Nickelate
papers.authors: Yinqi Hu, Yidian Li, Xian Du, Wenxuan Zhao, Kaiyi Zhai, Senyao Zhang, Jiawei Shao, Mingxin Mao, Houke Chen, Jieyi Liu, Donghui Lu, Makoto Hashimoto, Fangyuan Zhu, Zhengtai Liu, Dawei Shen, Yaobo Huang, Zhongkai Liu, D. Prabhakaran, Yanpeng Qi, Yilin Wang, Yulin Chen, Lexian Yang
papers.abstract: The discovery of high-temperature superconductivity in bilayer and trilayer nickelates has spurred intense interest in the Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates, yet the fundamental properties of the NiO 2 layer remain obscured by interlayer coupling. It is therefore imperative to investigate the electronic properties of their single-layer counterpart—though not superconducting—to isolate the intrinsic physics of the Ni-O layer. In this work, we present a systematic study of the single-layer nickelate La 1.4 Sr 0.6 NiO 4 using high-resolution angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and theoretical calculations. We reveal strong electron correlation effects manifested by high-energy kinks in band dispersions and a pronounced orbital-dependent band renormalization. Interestingly, we observe a quasi-one-dimensional electronic structure characterized by straight Fermi surface sheets along the diagonal momentum directions. Such a squarelike Fermi surface topology facilitates non-Fermi-liquid behavior consistent with the Luttinger liquid model, as evidenced by the power-law spectral function, robust temperature scaling, and spectroscopic features reminiscent of spin-charge separation. Our results therefore not only point toward an exotic Luttinger liquid phase emerging from the unexpected dimensional reduction in an intrinsically quasi-two-dimensional nickelate but also provide a new perspective for understanding the intriguing physics in multilayer nickelates.
papers.summary_en: Using La₁.₄Sr₀.₆NiO₄ as a single-layer nickelate platform, this study reports a quasi-one-dimensional electronic structure and spectroscopic signatures consistent with Luttinger-liquid behavior. The results connect an unexpected Fermi-surface topology with non-Fermi-liquid spectral properties in a material that is not superconducting.

papers.abstract: An anomalous Hall crystal (AHC) is a quantum state of matter, in which spontaneous electron crystallization leads to a quantized Hall effect without a magnetic field. The state can emerge in materials with strong Coulomb interaction and large Berry curvatures, such as few-layer rhombohedral graphene. Although the idea of AHCs has been invoked to explain some of the observed Chern insulators in moiré rhombohedral graphene (mRG), direct experimental evidence of AHCs has been missing so far. Here, we report experimental evidence of AHCs in hole-doped mRG through combined electrical transport and noise measurements. We identify a series of distinct Chern insulators spanning a broad and continuous range of doping densities incommensurate with the underlying moiré lattice; the states exhibit current-induced broadband noise and memory effects as well as pronounced gate hysteresis. Systematic magnetic field, temperature and gate dependence studies further support the emergence of a spontaneously charge-ordered state that acts as a parental state for the observed Chern insulators. The absence of Chern insulators at nearby integer fillings also distinguishes the observed state from the reported reentrant or extended quantum (anomalous) Hall states. Altogether, our results establish experimental evidence of AHCs in mRG and open the door for further exploration of the collective dynamics in this new state of matter.

papers.relevance_reason: The transport and noise measurements provide direct experimental evidence for a new collective electronic state in moiré graphene and its relation to Chern insulating phases.

papers.abstract: We present a $^{31}$P nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) study on the spin-$1/2$ bilayer triangular-lattice antiferromagnet K$_2$Co$_2$(HPO$_3$)$_2$(C$_2$O$_4$)(H$_2$O)$_2$. Measurements were performed at temperatures down to 0.06 K and magnetic fields up to 26 T. In the field range of 0.5 T to 4 T, the low-temperature spin-lattice relaxation rate $1/T_1$ exhibits a peak, signaling the onset of a magnetically ordered state. Within this ordered phase, $1/T_1$ shows gapless behavior, suggesting a spin supersolid phase. This ordering is suppressed around 4 T. Between 6 T and 18 T, clear splittings of the NMR spectra are observed, indicating the emergence of a second ordered magnetic phase. The field derivative of the low-temperature Knight shift $K_{\rm n}$ reveals changes in slope at approximately 10 T, 15.5 T, and 18 T. The first two features correspond to bulk magnetizations of $1/3$ and $2/3$ of the fully saturated moment, respectively, while the last one marks a quantum phase transition from the second ordered phase to the fully polarized state. These results establish the studied compound as a platform for investigating field-induced quantum phase transitions and emergent phases in frustrated bilayer triangular-lattice antiferromagnets.

papers.abstract: The quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) effect is usually realized through ferromagnetism or magnetic dop ing, which limits material choices and often results in low mobility, disorder sensitivity, and low operating temperatures. Here, we propose a mechanism to achieve the QAH phase without net magnetization, using altermagnetic exchange on a weak topological insulator (WTI). The altermagnetic order selectively gaps the Dirac cone at the Z point, while hybridization between the top and bottom surfaces of the WTI thin film opens a trivial gap at the point, generating a Chern number C = 1 phase with a single chiral edge channel. We verify the topological transition through both a minimal thin-film model and a slab geometry, and compute the associated Hall response. As altermagnets and layered WTIs already exist experimentally, this mechanism offers a promising and experimentally accessible route to realizing QAH phases without magnetic doping or global magnetization. The results indicate that altermagnetic surface engineering may provide a clean and controllable pathway for realizing dissipationless edge transport in layered quantum materials.

papers.relevance_reason: This is original theoretical work on topological electronic phases in altermagnetic and weak-topological-insulator materials, with a concrete experimentally testable proposal.

papers.abstract: We study the SU(3) Heisenberg chain with nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor antiferromagnetic exchange $J_1$ and $J_2$. Field theory predicts that the trimerized valence-bond solid of this chain has a finite extent in $α=J_2/J_1$, followed by a gapless SU(3)$_1$ phase, but earlier numerical estimates of the upper boundary range from $α\approx2.1$ (exact diagonalization) to $α\approx3.8$ (iDMRG). We use the variational uniform matrix product state (VUMPS) algorithm with the full non-Abelian SU(3) symmetry imposed on the virtual bonds, reaching bond dimensions up to $D\approx8000$, and locate the phase boundaries by finite-entanglement scaling. Resolving the transfer-matrix spectrum and the entanglement spectrum by SU(3) irreducible representation, we find that the trimerized phase extends to $α_{c2}\gtrsim3.5$ and end below $α\approx5$, excluding a boundary near $α\approx2$. At larger $α$ our numerical analysis of the effective central charge is consistent with the predicted massless flow from SU(3)$_2$ to SU(3)$_1$.
papers.physics_advance: The trimerized phase extends to at least α≈3.5 and ends below α≈5, excluding a previously proposed boundary near α≈2; at larger α, the results are consistent with massless flow from SU(3)₂ to SU(3)₁.

papers.abstract: Interlayer excitons (IXs) combine spatially separated electron and hole wavefunctions with electrically tunable dipole moments, but their reduced wavefunction overlap generally limits optical emission, particularly for high-energy states. Here we report a bright, spectrally narrow high-energy interlayer exciton (h-IX) near 2.23 eV in few-layer WSe2 and investigate how its optical activity evolves with layer number and sliding-ferroelectric polarization. In pristine 2H-WSe2, we observe thickness-dependent brightening of high-energy exciton emission. GW-BSE calculations reveal mixed intralayer and interlayer configurations with enhanced optical weight, suggesting that multilayer hybridization contributes to the observed brightening. In parallel-stacked 3L/3L WSe2 containing a sliding-ferroelectric interface, the h-IX exhibits polarization-dependent energies and Stark responses that distinguish Pup and Pdown domains. Electric-field-driven domain-wall motion produces hysteretic transfer of spectral weight between the two h-IX branches, enabling optical tracking of ferroelectric switching. These results establish multilayer hybridization as a route to optically active high-energy interlayer excitons and sliding ferroelectricity as a complementary degree of freedom for controlling their energy, dipole and emission.

papers.abstract: We study a $π$-flux square-lattice $t$-$t'$ Hofstadter-Hubbard model proposed to be realizable in twisted moiré bilayers. By tuning $U$ and $t'$ at half filling, ground-state density-matrix renormalization group simulations (DMRG) and a parton analysis identify an integer quantum Hall (IQH) phase, a chiral spin liquid (CSL), and an antiferromagnet (AFM) in the phase diagram, while charge and spin fluctuations from finite-temperature determinant quantum Monte Carlo (DQMC) suggest a closing charge gap but an open spin gap at the IQH-CSL boundary, consistent with the topological criticality expected there. This model therefore produces a phase diagram hosting weakly correlated band topology (IQH), intrinsic topological order (CSL), and conventional symmetry breaking (AFM) side by side. Upon doping any of these three parent phases, a single chiral topological superconductor with spin Chern number $C_s=-2$ occupies nearly the entire phase diagram. DMRG, DQMC, and weak-coupling perturbation theory agree on its pairing symmetry. This shows that doping the topological band of our model robustly induces the same paired state throughout the phase diagram regardless of the character of the underlying correlated half-filled state and its magnetic fluctuations, whether an IQH, a spin liquid or a weakly fluctuating AFM.

papers.abstract: Motivated by the observation of superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene in the proximity of electronic crystalline phases, we study the possibility of pairing mediated by electronic phonons. We focus on the vicinity of the phase boundary between trivial and topological electron crystals, where self-doping generically gives rise to a small Fermi sea of carriers with Dirac dispersion. We compute the Goldstone phonon spectra of the self-doped crystal (SDC) using a self-consistent approach, and subsequently derive the effective electronic-phonon-mediated interaction between itinerant carriers at the Fermi surface. Remarkably, we find that the Coulomb repulsion can be overscreened by the Goldstone phonons, leading to a chiral topological superconductor with an unpaired Majorana edge mode. Our conclusions are robust across the $λ$-jellium model and a simplified model of rhombohedral graphene, and we propose characteristic non-linear I-V signals as a test of our prediction. More generally, our results outline an intriguing route for unconventional superconductivity where both electronic correlations and topology play key roles.

papers.abstract: Resistive spin currents conventionally vary in space through spin relaxation or torque, which removes angular momentum from the transported spin. We here demonstrate a qualitatively different mechanism in a conventional superconductor exposed to a spin-splitting field. Spin injection across a spin-mixing interface activates a spin-supercurrent contribution, allowing the resistive spin current to vary spatially while the total spin current remains conserved. Even without a net spin-bias across the superconductor, finite and oppositely directed resistive and condensate spin currents arise. This produces a hidden spin-supercurrent counterflow with vanishing total spin and charge currents. The mechanism persists away from exact compensation and remains sizable over broad parameter ranges. The counterflow may be accessible through spin-to-charge conversion, either as a modification of the electrical response of spin-Hall injectors or through a local quasiparticle inverse spin-Hall signal. Our results establish condensate-mediated spin-current compensation as a previously overlooked alternative to spin relaxation.

papers.abstract: RuO$_2$, once the flagship altermagnetic candidate, is now believed to be nonmagnetic in the bulk, yet weak, static and spatially inhomogeneous magnetism emerges at its surfaces and interfaces. Where this magnetism resides, what stabilises it, and whether it is connected to these states remain open questions. Here we address these questions at the Nb/RuO$_2$ interface using a superconducting spin switch. A GdN/Nb/RuO$_2$ trilayer allows interfacial exchange-field alignment to tune the superconducting transition temperature of Nb, probing interfacial magnetism inaccessible to conventional magnetometry. The switch reveals a hidden magnetic subsystem, which we attribute to a thin RuO$_x$ redox layer formed as Nb scavenges oxygen from RuO$_2$. This layer behaves as a weak and magnetically hard ferromagnet with vacancy-induced anisotropy. Furthermore, supercurrent amplifies the switching efficiency, making the probe sensitivity tunable in situ. Superconducting spin switches thus emerge as a quantitative low-temperature probe of hidden magnetism at buried interfaces.

papers.abstract: Whether a lightly doped Mott insulator on the square lattice supports robust $d$-wave superconductivity remains a central question in strongly correlated physics and in the microscopic theory of cuprate superconductivity. Experiments and numerical studies reveal a pronounced particle-hole asymmetry, pointing to a delicate competition among $d$-wave superconductivity, pair-density wave (PDW), stripe, charge-density wave (CDW), and antiferromagnetic correlations. Here we combine large-scale DMRG and finite-size PEPS to study the square-lattice $t$-$J$ model at low doping, $δ\leq 0.1$, while tuning the next-nearest-neighbor hopping $t'$ from the electron-like ($t'>0$) to the hole-like ($t'<0$) regime. The electron-like side supports robust, nearly uniform $d$-wave pairing, whereas decreasing $t'$ induces a period-two plaquette modulation and ultimately produces, on the hole-like side, a charge-dominated state with a strongly suppressed static pairing amplitude. DMRG calculations on open strips and squares, together with PEPS calculations on open squares up to $16\times16$ sites, support this evolution. On squares with $C_4$-symmetric Hamiltonians, both methods find that the pair correlations of the hole-like state select the plaquette momenta $(π,0)$ and $(0,π)$ and decay within a few lattice spacings, while the dominant charge-density modulation forms a bidirectional checkerboard whose period extrapolates to about $4a_0$, close to that observed in lightly doped Bi-2201. These observations establish a fluctuating plaquette PDW in the lightly doped hole-like regime, in which local pairs carry finite momentum but lack phase coherence. Our results firmly establish particle-hole asymmetry as a central organizing principle for competing pairing tendencies in the lightly doped $t$-$J$ model.
papers.physics_advance: Finds a particle-hole-asymmetric evolution from robust uniform d-wave pairing to a hole-like state with short-range, finite-momentum plaquette pairing correlations and dominant period-four checkerboard charge order.
papers.relevance_reason: Large-scale numerical work on the doped t-J model directly addresses competing electronic orders in cuprate-relevant quantum materials.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察次近邻跃迁如何调控轻掺杂方格 t-J 模型中的竞争序，并发现电子型与空穴型区域之间存在显著的粒子—空穴不对称性。在空穴型一侧，研究发现短程有限动量配对关联与占主导的棋盘状电荷序并存。
papers.method_en: The authors use large-scale DMRG and finite-size PEPS for the square-lattice t-J model at doping δ≤0.1 while varying t′, including open strips and squares up to 16×16 sites. They compare pairing and charge correlations, with C4-symmetric Hamiltonians used to characterize the momentum structure of pair correlations.
papers.method_zh: 作者对掺杂度 δ≤0.1 的方格 t-J 模型开展大规模 DMRG 和有限尺寸 PEPS 计算，并改变 t′；计算体系包括开放条带和最大 16×16 格点的方形晶格。研究比较配对与电荷关联，并利用具有 C4 对称性的哈密顿量刻画配对关联的动量结构。
papers.result_en: The electron-like regime supports robust, nearly uniform d-wave pairing, whereas decreasing t′ induces period-two plaquette modulation and the hole-like regime becomes charge-dominated with strongly suppressed static pairing. On C4-symmetric squares, both methods find hole-like pair correlations concentrated at plaquette momenta (π,0) and (0,π), decaying within a few lattice spacings, while the dominant bidirectional charge modulation extrapolates to a period of about 4a₀. The authors interpret this combination as a fluctuating plaquette pair-density wave: local pairs carry finite momentum but lack phase coherence. The charge period is reported to be close to that observed in lightly doped Bi-2201.
papers.result_zh: 电子型区域支持稳健、近乎均匀的 d 波配对；随着 t′ 减小，会出现周期为二的 plaquette 调制，而空穴型区域则转为电荷主导，静态配对显著受抑。在具有 C4 对称性的方形体系中，两种方法都发现空穴型配对关联集中于 plaquette 动量 (π,0) 和 (0,π)，并在数个晶格间距内衰减；占主导的双向电荷调制外推周期约为 4a₀。作者将这一组合解释为涨落的 plaquette 配对密度波：局域配对具有有限动量，但不具备相位相干性。报告的电荷周期接近轻掺杂 Bi-2201 中观测到的周期。
papers.future_en: A useful follow-up would test the robustness of the proposed fluctuating plaquette PDW across larger systems and model parameters, and compare its charge and pairing signatures directly with experiments on lightly doped cuprates.
papers.future_zh: 后续研究可在更大体系和不同模型参数下检验所提出的涨落 plaquette 配对密度波是否稳健，并将其电荷与配对特征直接同轻掺杂铜氧化物实验进行比较。
papers.tier_reason_en: The combination of complementary large-scale numerical methods and a specific finite-momentum pairing result in a central cuprate model supports a strong, broadly relevant condensed-matter contribution, though the evidence is model-based.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 该工作结合互补的大规模数值方法，并在重要的铜氧化物模型中得到明确的有限动量配对结果，具有较强且广泛相关的凝聚态物理意义；不过，证据仍主要来自模型研究。

papers.abstract: Several unconventional superconducting phases have been discovered in the vicinity of metamagnetism in the heavy-fermion paramagnet UTe$_2$ under magnetic field. To describe the mechanism of magnetic-field-induced superconductivity, a challenge is to characterize the quantum critical magnetic properties at the metamagnetic transition. In this work, we investigate the thermodynamic properties of UTe$_2$ under magnetic fields up to 60~T applied in the crystallographic $\mathbf{b}-\mathbf{c}$ plane. Magnetization and magnetostriction experiments have been performed under magnetic fields tilted by an angle $θ\lesssim42^\circ$ from $\mathbf{b}$ toward $\mathbf{c}$. They support that a quantum critical endpoint at the field angle $θ_{QCEP}\simeq(70\pm10)^\circ$ and magnetic field $μ_0H_{QCEP}\simeq(75\pm10)$~T terminates the metamagnetic transition line. A pseudo-gap in the magnetic susceptibility is related with the metamagnetic transition observed in magnetic fields for $θ<θ_{QCEP}$. The possible relation between the quantum critical endpoint and the development of magnetic-field-induced superconductivity is discussed.
papers.physics_advance: Magnetization and magnetostriction support a quantum critical endpoint near 75 T and a field angle of 70°; the study also relates a susceptibility pseudogap to the metamagnetic transition.
papers.relevance_reason: High-field thermodynamic measurements on the heavy-fermion superconductor UTe₂ establish a material-specific quantum-critical result relevant to its metamagnetism and field-induced superconductivity.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究通过UTe₂的高磁场热力学测量，为其变磁转变线终止于量子临界端点（QCEP）提供支持，并讨论该端点与磁场诱导超导之间可能的联系。
papers.method_en: The authors measure magnetization and magnetostriction in fields up to 60 T, applied in the crystallographic b–c plane at angles up to about 42° from the b axis. They use the angular and field dependence of these thermodynamic quantities to infer the endpoint and characterize the metamagnetic transition.
papers.method_zh: 作者在最高60 T、位于晶体学b–c平面且相对b轴倾角最高约42°的磁场下测量磁化强度和磁致伸缩。他们利用这些热力学量对角度和磁场的依赖性推断临界端点，并表征变磁转变。
papers.result_en: The measurements support a QCEP at an angle θ_QCEP ≃ (70 ± 10)° and field μ₀H_QCEP ≃ (75 ± 10) T, where the metamagnetic transition line terminates. A pseudogap in the magnetic susceptibility is associated with the metamagnetic transition for angles θ < θ_QCEP. The inferred endpoint lies above the maximum measurement field of 60 T. The authors discuss, but do not establish, a possible relationship between the QCEP and the development of field-induced superconductivity.
papers.result_zh: 测量结果支持变磁转变线在角度θ_QCEP ≃ (70 ± 10)°、磁场μ₀H_QCEP ≃ (75 ± 10) T处终止于QCEP。对于θ < θ_QCEP，磁化率中的赝能隙与变磁转变相关。推断的端点磁场高于60 T的最高测量磁场。作者讨论了QCEP与磁场诱导超导发展之间可能存在的联系，但并未确立这种联系。
papers.future_en: Measurements extending to fields near the inferred ≃75 T endpoint could test the proposed termination of the transition line directly. Further work could also determine whether, and how, the endpoint is related to field-induced superconductivity.
papers.future_zh: 将测量拓展至接近推断的约75 T端点的磁场，可直接检验转变线终止这一判断。后续研究也可进一步确定该端点是否以及如何与磁场诱导超导相关。
papers.tier_reason_en: The study provides useful thermodynamic evidence for a high-field QCEP and characterizes its angular relation to metamagnetism, but the inferred endpoint lies beyond the maximum applied field and the proposed superconductivity connection remains open. On the abstract alone, this supports a solid specialist-journal assessment rather than a broader high-tier placement.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 该研究为高磁场QCEP提供了有价值的热力学证据，并刻画其与变磁性之间的角度关系；但推断的端点超出已施加的最高磁场，与超导的联系也仍未确定。仅依据摘要，较适合评价为扎实的专业期刊工作，而非更高层级的广泛影响型成果。

papers.summary_en: This work proposes and analyzes “borrowed” Planckian dissipation in magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene, where Dirac carriers acquire scattering associated with flat-band electrons as displacement field breaks mirror symmetry. It combines resistance measurements across eight fields with a transport analysis to derive a predicted relation between field-differential transport and entropy.

papers.abstract: In strange metals, the ratio of the coefficients producing signature linear-in-$T$ resistivity and the logarithmic specific heat is free of the coupling between the electrons and whatever scatters them. In the materials studied so far that coupling is fixed by chemistry. Magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene provides a dial with a displacement field $D$ that breaks the mirror symmetry separating a light Dirac cone from the flat bands, and the Dirac carriers borrow the Planckian self-energy of the flat band with a weight proportional to $D^2+D_0^2$. Resistance curves taken at eight fields are consistent with the field acting on the scattering rate rather than on the number of carriers. The slope in temperature follows $a(1+D^2/D_0^2)$ without the quartic term that a depleting Dirac pocket adds, and the elastic part varies by less than 5\% between 0.20 and 0.30~V/nm while the inelastic part grows 2.5-fold up to 0.38~V/nm. The thermally averaged Kubo formula favors flat-band weight placed symmetrically about the Fermi level over a single level. Borrowed dissipation keeps the bath exponent and transport prefactor of the flat band's own electrons but carries exactly twice their entropy per unit of borrowed coupling whenever the bath has dynamics of its own, so the field-differential ratio is $2π^3/21ζ(3)\approx2.46$ for a conformal flat band and, in a numerical search, at most 2.73 for monotonic bath spectra without a high-energy rate floor. The discriminating test is the entropy measured in steps of $D$.

papers.relevance_reason: The work combines transport observations and theoretical analysis to identify a distinctive Planckian dissipation mechanism in a moiré electronic material.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究提出并分析了魔角扭转三层石墨烯中的“借用”Planck耗散：位移场打破镜面对称性后，Dirac载流子获得与平带电子相关的散射。研究结合八个场值下的电阻测量与输运分析，推导场微分输运量与熵之间的预测关系。
papers.method_en: The authors analyze resistance curves measured at eight displacement-field values and compare their temperature-dependent slopes and elastic contributions. They also evaluate a thermally averaged Kubo formula and use a numerical search over monotonic bath spectra to assess the proposed transport-to-entropy relation.
papers.method_zh: 作者分析了八个位移场值下测得的电阻曲线，并比较其温度依赖斜率与弹性贡献。他们还计算热平均Kubo公式，并通过对单调浴谱进行数值搜索来评估所提出的输运—熵关系。
papers.result_en: The temperature slope is reported to follow a(1 + D²/D₀²), without the quartic term expected from depletion of a Dirac pocket, while the resistance curves are consistent with displacement field affecting the scattering rate rather than the carrier number. The elastic contribution changes by less than 5% between 0.20 and 0.30 V/nm, whereas the inelastic contribution grows by a factor of 2.5 up to 0.38 V/nm. The Kubo analysis favors flat-band spectral weight distributed symmetrically about the Fermi level over a single level. For a bath with its own dynamics, the proposed borrowed dissipation carries twice the entropy per unit borrowed coupling of the flat-band electrons; the predicted field-differential ratio is 2π³/[21ζ(3)] ≈ 2.46 for a conformal flat band and reaches at most 2.73 in the stated numerical search for monotonic bath spectra without a high-energy rate floor.
papers.result_zh: 据报告，温度斜率遵循a(1 + D²/D₀²)，不含Dirac口袋耗尽所预期的四次项；电阻曲线则与位移场改变散射率而非载流子数的解释相符。在0.20至0.30 V/nm之间，弹性贡献变化小于5%；而在位移场升至0.38 V/nm时，非弹性贡献增至原来的2.5倍。Kubo分析更支持平带谱权重关于费米能级对称分布，而非集中在单一能级。对于自身具有动力学的浴，所提出的借用耗散每单位借用耦合所携带的熵是平带电子的两倍；共形平带的场微分比值预测为2π³/[21ζ(3)] ≈ 2.46，而所述数值搜索中，对不含高能散射率下限的单调浴谱，该比值最高为2.73。
papers.future_en: The abstract identifies entropy measured in steps of displacement field as a discriminating test of the proposed mechanism. Such measurements could assess the predicted field-differential ratio and help distinguish borrowed flat-band dissipation from alternative explanations of the resistance trends.
papers.future_zh: 摘要指出，逐步改变位移场并测量熵，是检验所提出机制的判别性实验。此类测量可评估预测的场微分比值，并有助于将借用平带耗散与其他电阻趋势解释区分开来。
papers.tier_reason_en: The work combines a tunable transport study with a specific quantitative prediction linking dissipation to entropy, including a numerical bound and a proposed discriminating test. This is a potentially impactful and focused result, but the abstract does not indicate the breadth or independent experimental validation needed to justify a higher broad-interest tier.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 该研究将可调控输运测量与耗散—熵之间的具体定量预测结合起来，并给出数值上限及可用于判别的实验检验。这是一项可能具有影响力且主题集中的成果；但摘要未显示足以支持更高综合性期刊层级所需的广泛影响或独立实验验证。

papers.title: Direction-Selective Anomalous Quantum Transport from Saddle-like Topological Surface States Coupled to an Electronic Instability in YbSb$_{2}$
papers.announcement_time_basis: arXiv dated batch and official 20:00 Eastern release schedule

papers.summary_en: This work reports direction-selective quantum oscillations in YbSb₂ films and relates them to anisotropic topological surface states and a low-temperature density-wave instability. The oscillation and spectroscopic responses are strongly anisotropic and show behavior that departs from conventional expectations.
papers.summary: We report direction-selective anomalous quantum transport in epitaxial YbSb$_{2}$ thin films associated with an interplay between anisotropic topological surface states and an electronic instability. papers.abstract: We report direction-selective anomalous quantum transport in epitaxial YbSb$_{2}$ thin films associated with an interplay between anisotropic topological surface states and an electronic instability. Quantum oscillations reveal a quasi-two-dimensional orbit with a non-trivial Berry phase and Dirac-like dispersion, observable for current along the $a$-axis but absent along the orthogonal in-plane $c$-axis. Together with first-principles calculations, these observations support its assignment to a saddle-like topological surface state. Its oscillation amplitude exhibits a field-dependent, non-monotonic temperature evolution that departs from conventional Lifshitz-Kosevich behavior. Raman and coherent phonon spectroscopy reveal additional low-temperature modes consistent with a density-wave instability. Their pronounced polarization anisotropy and colossal field-induced Raman enhancement suggest a strongly anisotropic, field-enhanced electronic susceptibility associated with the density-wave modes. Our findings point to dynamical coupling between anisotropic topological surface states and a field-responsive density-wave instability as a route to direction-selective anomalous quantum transport.
papers.physics_advance: YbSb2 exhibits direction-selective quantum oscillations associated with a saddle-like topological surface state, alongside anisotropic, field-responsive density-wave modes that depart from conventional Lifshitz-Kosevich behavior.
papers.relevance_reason: The experiments and calculations connect anisotropic topological surface states, a density-wave instability, and direction-selective anomalous quantum transport in a solid-state material.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报道了 YbSb₂ 薄膜中具有方向选择性的量子振荡，并将其与各向异性拓扑表面态及低温密度波不稳定性联系起来。振荡和光谱响应表现出强烈各向异性，且部分行为偏离常规预期。
papers.method_en: The authors combine directional quantum-oscillation measurements in epitaxial YbSb₂ films with first-principles calculations, Raman spectroscopy, and coherent-phonon spectroscopy. They examine the oscillation’s temperature and field dependence and the polarization and field response of low-temperature modes.
papers.method_zh: 作者将外延 YbSb₂ 薄膜的分方向量子振荡测量与第一性原理计算、拉曼光谱及相干声子光谱相结合。他们考察振荡的温度和磁场依赖性，以及低温模式的偏振和磁场响应。
papers.result_en: A quasi-two-dimensional orbit with a nontrivial Berry phase and Dirac-like dispersion is observed for current along the a-axis but not the orthogonal in-plane c-axis, supporting its assignment to a saddle-like topological surface state. Its oscillation amplitude has a non-monotonic, field-dependent temperature evolution that deviates from Lifshitz–Kosevich behavior, while Raman and coherent-phonon data reveal low-temperature modes consistent with a density-wave instability. The modes show pronounced polarization anisotropy and colossal field-induced Raman enhancement, which the authors associate with an anisotropic, field-enhanced electronic susceptibility. They propose dynamical coupling between the surface states and density-wave instability as a route to the direction-selective transport.
papers.result_zh: 沿 a 轴电流时可观测到具有非平庸 Berry 相和类 Dirac 色散的准二维轨道，而沿面内正交的 c 轴电流时则观测不到；这一结果支持将其归属为鞍点型拓扑表面态。该轨道的振荡幅度随温度呈非单调且依赖磁场的变化，偏离 Lifshitz–Kosevich 行为；拉曼和相干声子数据则揭示了与密度波不稳定性相符的低温模式。这些模式表现出显著的偏振各向异性和巨大的磁场诱导拉曼增强，作者将其与各向异性且受磁场增强的电子易感性联系起来。作者提出，表面态与密度波不稳定性之间的动态耦合可能导致方向选择性输运。
papers.future_en: Further work could independently establish the density-wave character of the low-temperature modes and clarify how their field-dependent response is linked to the direction-selective quantum oscillations.
papers.future_zh: 后续研究可进一步独立确认低温模式的密度波属性，并厘清其磁场依赖响应与方向选择性量子振荡之间的联系。
papers.tier_reason_en: The combination of transport and spectroscopy is interesting, but the assignment of the orbit and the proposed coupling to a density-wave instability remain interpretive in the abstract, making a specialist-level tier the best-supported judgment.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 输运与光谱结果的结合颇具意义，但摘要中的轨道归属以及其与密度波不稳定性的耦合解释仍带有推断性，因此专业领域期刊层级最为合适。
